findings: lwipopts.h selects MEMP_MEM_MALLOC=1, but Espressif memp.c still rejects a TCP PCB allocation when num_tcp_pcb reaches MEMP_NUM_TCP_PCB. The limit is 16 in this image.
tcp_alloc attempts to reclaim the oldest TIME_WAIT PCB after an allocation refusal. tcp_slowtmr expires TIME_WAIT after 2 * TCP_MSL.
These facts do not identify the observed fragmentation. The existing codec-only allocation trace excludes Wi-Fi, TCP, TLS and HTTP allocations.
next_measurement: Trace bounded network allocation sizes/lifetimes or coherent heap and TCP counts during a long HE32 HTTP / HE64 HTTPS run; keep all current acceptance thresholds.
